programme.title: In the Shackles of Frost 4 – Step by step | S04E18
programme.desc: The fourth season of the documentary story about the fate of the inhabitants of Alaska. Sue Aikens, Jessie Holmes, Glenn Villaneuve and the Hailstones try to survive the harsh winter. For another year in a row, they take up the challenge nature throws at them. The Hailstones are working hard to develop the land they inherited from Agnes' grandparents. Jessie, on the other hand, takes part in a moose hunt. It soon turns out that he is not the only one looking for these deer. Alaskans need to make the most of the warm days to prepare for the upcoming freeze. The Hailstons are starting the summer harvest season. They will look for, among others: egg seagulls. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Cuba: A trip to the Caribbean | E01
programme.desc: Colin Stafford Johnson takes viewers back to a time just 50 years ago when Earth's wildlife seemed abundant. It is a journey into a world that may soon disappear forever. The expedition begins in the south of the island in the Zapata Swamp. The largest single protected area in the entire Caribbean is home to the world's smallest bird, the bee hummingbird. Decades of a conservation-minded socialist government, US embargoes and minimal development have left the region largely unchanged for five decades. Regardless of politics, Cuba's isolation has created a natural citadel in the Caribbean. Forests cover large areas of the island, and its waters contain some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Half of Cuba's flora and fauna are found only here - from the local species of crocodiles and snakes to the smallest birds and frogs on the planet. Colin Stafford Johnson begins his expedition in the swamps of the Zapata Peninsula. Cuba's isolation means that there are places that have remained unchanged for decades, and the coral reef is one of the richest in the world. Austria. 2020. documentary film

programme.desc: «The league of... (T1): All the president's ultras» The presidents attend, astonished, the appearance in Spain of the ultra fans movement. They don't really know how to relate to them, but they are clear that they don't want them against them. To keep them happy, they give them privileges; After all, presidents are the first fans. Joan Gaspart, former president of the F.C. Barcelona boasts of being one of the Boixos Nois, the ultras of Barça. At the same time, their egos invite them to challenge each other, with cocky attitudes that begin with mockery and end in punches. These presidential attitudes are reproduced in the stadiums: dirty play, insults to the referee and racist chants are the order of the day. In this spiral of violence, the ultras cross the red line with physical attacks that end with the murder of Aitor Zabaleta. This death will mark a turning point, and the presidents will have to decide whether to protect or confront this monster that they themselves fed.

America's Wild Seasons: Spring (S1 E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2020. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep1 «America's Wild Seasons»…Across the continent, the land and its wildlife breathe in warmth and renewal. For some animals, courtship rituals begin to heat up as battles for dominance break out. For others, it's the time to tend to brand new lifeThe wilds of America are vast and untamed. Over the course of a year, this immersive documentary series investigates the perils and challenges faced by the animals that inhabit these ferocious wildernesses. Through winter, spring, summer and autumn witness how the ever changing conditions affect life on land, below the waves and in the air. The personalities and characters of certain animals will develop as the series progress and you will find yourself rooting for your favourites to survive as the seasons go by. America's seasons are wild and extreme posing many trails to the varied wildlife that live there. From freezing rains to scorching deserts, the weather is as scary and unpredictable as it could possibly be. Nature documentary seriesDirector: Jeff MoralesCast: Scott McNeil

programme.title: Deep Dive North America: Strange Shores (S1 E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2024. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2024. S1, Ep5 «Deep Dive North America»…Tag along with Lizzie on her most dangerous Atlantic adventure yet: free diving with bull sharks. Explore otherworldly Gulf Coast swamps filled with hungry alligators, crafty snapping turtles, and tiny but mighty beach mice who strengthen sand dunesStrap in for a thrilling ride as Lizzie travels by air, land, and sea to meet Alaskan wildlife and visit the world's remotest corners. Eavesdrop on underwater Arctic residents with scientists, dine with polar bears, and scavenge with bald eaglesDirector: Mark WoodwardCast: Lizzie Daly

programme.title: Cub Camp: The Littlest Cub (S1 E1). Documentary about nature. England, 2024. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2024. S1, Ep1 «Cub Camp»…Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human worldFollow Judy and Roger Stearns, two regular people with a little bit of land and a lot of heart, as they care for traumatised black bear cubsDirector: Shereen Jerrett

programme.title: Cub Camp: Meet the X-Girls (S1 E2). Documentary about nature. England, 2024. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2024 г. Год: 2024. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2024. S1, Ep2 «Cub Camp»…Welcome sisters Xiba, Xyla, and Xola, a trio of starving orphans who turn Winston's world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. Then monitor new cubs Yasmine and Yara, who get reacquainted after a stressful separationFollow Judy and Roger Stearns, two regular people with a little bit of land and a lot of heart, as they care for traumatised black bear cubsDirector: Shereen Jerrett

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti: Back to the Wild (S1 E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kenija, 2025. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2025 г. Год: 2025. Страна: Kenija. Год: 2025. S1, Ep2 «Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti»…Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named KisimaDirector: Nicola Tremain

programme.title: Wild Tales From the Farm: Leaping Into Life (S1 E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1 «Wild Tales From the Farm»…It's spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. programme.title: d/s Best friends. 6 p.
programme.desc: Mini horse Spanky gets a new chance thanks to Jack Russell terrier Dally. And a King Charles cavalier named Lola found solace with her best friend, Pepper Rabbit. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Canada

programme.title: d/s Best friends (Seamus, Puck, Amani and Winsper)
programme.desc: Rescued mountain dog Seamus befriends a Maine Coon. At the Dallas Zoo, friendly Labrador Amani makes the perfect partner for shy and restless cheetah Winsper. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Canada

programme.title: d/s Best friends (Prince, Banksy, Zach and Major)
programme.desc: The tiny prairie dog Prince is quite capable of holding his own in a fight with the German shepherd Banksy. The spoiled squirrel Zach becomes friends with a retriever named Major. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Canada

programme.title: d/s Australian Wildlife Rescue (Patsy the Echidna)
programme.desc: Patsy the echidna came to examine his broken beak, Ollie the pelican had a severely torn sac and if not treated, he would not survive, and Crash the bandicoot lost his mother. Australia

programme.title: d/s Ancient China from a bird's eye view (Hebei)
programme.desc: This amazing documentary series uses satellite and LiDAR technology to take viewers back in time to get a bird's eye view of how China's earlier landscapes were shaped. Each episode immerses the viewer into the world of long-forgotten wonders, revealing a new dimension and admiration for the history of the Chinese land. Dir.: Anthony Barwell, Christopher O'Donnell. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Jungle Planet (World of Thorn)
programme.desc: The thorn forest on the island of Madagascar is home to a variety of plants and animals that have managed to adapt to the harsh environment. Unique lemurs, chameleons and nightjars live here in close connection with each other. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano. Spain

programme.title: d/f I am the best red deer
programme.desc: In autumn, an amazing and exciting story begins in the Mediterranean forest. The Iberian red deer enters the mating season, when its alarming sounds are heard throughout the forest. This is the time when deer defend their territory, compete for the attention of females, and guard their pack. Continuation of the species becomes their main goal, and every battle is not just a fight, but also a chance to secure the future of their species

programme.title: d/f Mysteries of the Ocean
programme.desc: The underwater world is full of mysteries and wonders. The ocean, with its endless expanses, attracts humanity with its unexplored wealth. What secrets is he hiding from us? This fascinating story dives into the deepest recesses of the ocean to show us life in its depths and reveal the majesty of underwater worlds hidden from human eyes. USA

programme.title: d/s Green animals (Hunger satisfaction)
programme.desc: In this series, we will explore which plants can help satisfy the hunger of different animal species. Director: Song Seung-woo. South Korea

programme.title: d/s Amazing animal families. 2 s.
programme.desc: Strong leadership and clear communication are essential for family cohesion in gorillas. Meanwhile, beavers even improve the lives of their neighbors with their burrows. Australia

programme.title: d/f Wonders of the North from above. 1 p.
programme.desc: In Iceland, we follow the Icelandic ponies, half wild and half tame, as they race in herds across the icy landscapes. This land of ice and fire offers a variety of sights: gushing geysers and furious volcanoes. Spain, Australia

programme.title: d/s Animal Superpowers (Sky)
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? How do bats and moths use their unusual ears and antennae for orientation? In each episode, we explore how these features, which at first glance seem strange, play a key role in survival. Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. USA, Czech Republic

programme.title: d/s Superpowers of animals (Under the cover of night)
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? How do bats and moths use their unusual ears and antennae for orientation? In each episode, we explore how these features, which at first glance seem strange, play a key role in survival. Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. USA, Czech Republic

programme.desc: Stallion Jumper experiences a foal birth in the stable and observes another horse's "natural jump". Tamme Hanken then looks for a suitable mare for him. (Station info).

programme.title: The XXL East Frisian – On the road with “bone crusher” Tamme Hanken

programme.title: National Parks – Protected natural wonders
programme.desc: Wild mountains and traces of British industrial history characterize Eryri. Between harsh nature, tourism and gentle agriculture, a multi-faceted picture of the Welsh national park emerges. (Station info).

programme.title: National Parks – Protected natural wonders
programme.desc: In Göreme National Park, fairy chimneys and early Christian cave churches dominate the landscape. Cappadocia is also home to semi-wild horses, a symbol of the region. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: Ken O'Sullivan begins his journey in the dark waters off the coast of Northern Ireland. From there, the underwater filmmaker delves into the hidden secrets of the North Atlantic. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: This journey takes the underwater filmmaker into the barely explored world of the North Atlantic. Ken O'Sullivan is the first to document the migration routes of fin whales along the south coast of Ireland. (Station info).

programme.title: Chasing the rain
programme.desc: Three herds of elephants, three lead cows, one goal: to find water in an unprecedented drought. Will each of the experienced matriarchs be successful in their vital quest? (Station info).

programme.title: Chasing the rain
programme.desc: Elephants are extremely creative when drought threatens their lives. They dig emergency wells. A young cheetah could no longer withstand the drought and died. (Station info).

programme.title: Sharks of the North Atlantic
programme.desc: The naturalist goes to the North Atlantic for the special on “Sharks – with Steve Backshall”. The rough waters are home to a variety of elegant sea predators. (Station info).

programme.title: National Parks – Protected natural wonders
programme.desc: Los Glaciares shows the ruggedly beautiful part of Patagonia: huge glaciers, turquoise lakes and strong winds. Mountain guides report on climate change, glacier retreat and the preservation of the landscape. (Station info).

programme.title: National Parks – Protected natural wonders
programme.desc: Lush green mountains, barren plateaus and deep gorges characterize a barely discovered region. Transhumance, Mont Aigoual and the Aven Armand cave offer impressive natural experiences. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic

programme.title: Alien Abyss – Extraterrestrial Depth
programme.desc: Glowing tentacles, huge octopuses, monster-like fish - our oceans are up to 11 km deep and their creatures are shrouded in myth. The New Zealander Job Rustenhoven (“Wonders of the Ocean”) not only appears on the doorstep in three Monday episodes.

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit

programme.desc: Two squirrel monkeys have an important mission at Taronga Zoo. The two should mate with as many females as possible. Unfortunately, the approach attempts end with a broken jaw. (Station info).

programme.title: Germany from above

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: 30 years of elephant stories - Andreas Kieling accompanies the gentle giants: How are the pachyderms doing in India's rainy season and how do they survive Namibia's extreme drought? (Station info).

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World

programme.title: Terra X
programme.desc: Dear gender theorists, you have to be very brave now: When young baboons are allowed to choose between different children's toys, girl monkeys prefer dolls, while monkey boys choose cars. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại chính mình lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh của thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

programme.title: THỢ SĂN MÁU: SỰ TRỖI DẬY CỦA QUÁI VẬT LAI - BLOOD HUNTERS: RISE OF THE HYBRI
programme.desc: Gabriella bị thôi thúc bởi sự trả thù sau khi một con quái vật lai tàn sát gia đình cô. Trong nhiệm vụ của mình, cô gia nhập một đội Thợ săn máu và họ cùng nhau tiến hành cuộc chiến chống lại các lãnh chúa tàn nhẫn của thế giới ngầm, gây ra một cuộc đối đầu tàn khốc.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ TỬ THẦN - AGENT OF DEATH
programme.desc: Sau khi trải qua một thí nghiệm bí mật của chính phủ, đặc vụ Tara của CIA có được khả năng biến hình thành bất kỳ ai thông qua quá trình biến đổi DNA, khiến cô trở thành kẻ xâm nhập tối thượng. Khi cha cô bị sát hại và bằng chứng chỉ ra cơ quan của chính cô, cô buộc phải trở thành kẻ lừa đảo. Bây giờ, cô phải ngăn chặn uranium bị đánh cắp gây ra thảm họa hạt nhân toàn cầu.

programme.title: HỎA VÂN TÀ THẦN: MẶT NẠ TU LA - THE MASK OF SHURA OF FIRE CLOUD
programme.desc: 18 năm trước, tộc Black Feather độc ác đã xâm nhập vào lãnh thổ của Master Fire Cloud và đánh cắp Mặt nạ Shura, từ đó giải phóng một linh hồn tà ác là một đứa bé. Master Fire Cloud đã nhận nuôi đứa bé để ngăn cậu trở thành ác quỷ. Khi đứa bé lớn lên, nó nắm quyền điều khiển chiếc mặt nạ và trở thành người kế nhiệm Fire Cloud với tư cách là người bảo vệ thành phố.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.desc: Hàng ngàn năm trước, Green Snake đã được giác ngộ dưới sự hướng dẫn của Dao Qing và dần dần phải lòng anh ta. Tuy nhiên, sự tận tâm của cô dành cho Dao Qing đã khiến anh tái sinh và trải qua nỗi đau của cái chết. Kể từ đó, cô bắt đầu tìm kiếm những tái sinh của Đạo Thanh trong hàng trăm năm để giúp anh lật ngược tình thế…

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh thời kỳ hỗn loạn của Tam Quốc. Tào Tháo cố gắng chiêu mộ Quan Vũ vào lực lượng của mình, nhưng Quan trung thành với người anh em kết nghĩa Lưu Bị, cũng là kẻ thù của Tào Tháo. Khi Quan cố gắng giải cứu vợ lẽ của Lưu Bị khỏi tay Tào Tháo, anh ta buộc phải chiến đấu để vượt qua. Liệu cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công?
